# Smart cards and signing online (timestamps, revocation information).

column2: Use a smart card or token
No signing certificate was found on a card. Is the card in the reader?
column3: Tidak ada sertifikat penandatanganan yang ditemukan di kartu. Apakah kartu ada di pembaca?

column2: The PIN goes only to the card; PdfCraft doesn't keep it.
column3: PIN hanya dikirim ke kartu; PdfCraft tidak menyimpannya.

column2: The smart card's digital IDs couldn't be listed: {e}
column3: ID digital kartu pintar tidak dapat dicantumkan: {e}

column2: Signing then goes online: the timestamp server receives a hash of the signature, and the certificate authorities are asked whether the certificates are revoked. With both, signatures are PAdES B-LTA.
column3: Penandatanganan lalu terhubung ke jaringan: server stempel waktu menerima hash tanda tangan, dan otoritas sertifikat ditanya apakah sertifikat dicabut. Dengan keduanya, tanda tangan menjadi PAdES B-LTA.

column2: Timestamps and revocation information need the desktop app. Turn them off in Preferences > Signatures to sign here.
column3: Stempel waktu dan informasi pencabutan memerlukan aplikasi desktop. Matikan di Preferensi > Tanda tangan untuk menandatangani di sini.

column2: Signing was cancelled; nothing was saved.
column3: Penandatanganan dibatalkan; tidak ada yang disimpan.

column2: Signed and saved to {path}, without some revocation information: {problems}
column3: Ditandatangani dan disimpan ke {path}, tanpa sebagian informasi pencabutan: {problems}
